vocab.definition: an object that is used to climb up and down

vocab.definition: a coin worth one cent

vocab.example: Historians generally acknowledge her as a genius in her field.
vocab.cn_example: 历史学家们公认她是该领域中的天才。

vocab.definition: a government worker who works in another country
vocab.example: The UK's ambassador in Moscow has refused to comment.
vocab.cn_example: 英国驻莫斯科大使已拒绝发表评论。

vocab.definition: a person with light-colored hair
vocab.example: Who's the blonde talking to Bob?
vocab.cn_example: 与鲍勃讲话的那个金发女郎是谁？

vocab.definition: to attack and take control of it
vocab.example: The Spanish conquered the New World in the 16th century.
vocab.cn_example: 西班牙人在16世纪征服了新大陆。

vocab.definition: to pull it across the ground
vocab.example: Pick the chair up instead of dragging it behind you!
vocab.cn_example: 把椅子拿起来，不要在地上拖！

vocab.definition: to say that something is bigger or better than it really is
vocab.example: The threat of attack has been greatly exaggerated.
vocab.cn_example: 遭受袭击的威胁被过分夸大了。

vocab.definition: the collection of features of a society, such as language and religion
vocab.cn_meaning: 遗产（指流传下来的具有历史意义的传统、语言、建筑等）
vocab.example: These monuments are a vital part of the cultural heritage of South America.
vocab.cn_example: 这些纪念碑是南美文化遗产的重要组成部分.

vocab.definition: to say things that will hurt the person’s feelings
vocab.example: First he drank all my wine and then he insulted all my friends.
vocab.cn_example: 他先喝光了我的酒，然后又辱骂了我所有的朋友。

vocab.definition: happens at the same time as another action
vocab.example: Carl's starting college in September. Meanwhile, he's travelling around Europe.
vocab.cn_example: 卡尔9月将开始大学生活。此间他将会环游欧洲。

vocab.definition: a piece of jewelry that people wear around their necks
vocab.example: a gold/silver/pearl necklace
vocab.cn_example: 金／银／珍珠项链

vocab.definition: a rich and powerful person
vocab.example: a noble family
vocab.cn_example: 贵族家庭

vocab.definition: valuable and important
vocab.example: a precious gift
vocab.cn_example: 珍贵的礼物

vocab.definition: an unfair opinion about people based on the group they belong to
vocab.example: Laws against racial prejudice must be strictly enforced.
vocab.cn_example: 禁止种族歧视的法律必须严格执行。

vocab.definition: a story that may not be true
vocab.example: Rumours are going round (the school) about Mr Mason and his assistant.
vocab.cn_example: 有关梅森先生和他助手的流言蜚语（在学校里）满天飞。

vocab.definition: something that is wrong for religious reasons
vocab.cn_meaning: （违反宗教戒律或道德规范的）罪，罪过
vocab.example: to commit/confess a sin
vocab.cn_example: 犯罪／忏悔罪过

vocab.definition: an amazing sight
vocab.example: The carnival was a magnificent spectacle.
vocab.cn_example: 嘉年华场面十分壮观。

vocab.definition: a pile of different things
vocab.example: He chose a cartoon from the stack of DVDs on the shelf.
vocab.cn_example: 他从架子上的一摞DVD中挑了盘卡通片。

vocab.definition: does not trust others, or is not trusted by others
vocab.cn_meaning: 怀疑的，猜疑的;不信任的
vocab.example: His colleagues became suspicious (= thought that there was something wrong) when he did not appear at work, since he was always punctual.
vocab.cn_example: 他一向按时来上班，所以当他没有来上班时，他的同事们起了疑心。

vocab.definition: an inexpensive metal
vocab.example: a tin of beans
vocab.cn_example: 一听豆子

vocab.definition: an attractive container in which people keep flowers
vocab.example: a vase of flowers
vocab.cn_example: 一瓶花

vocab.definition: to hurt, or cause pain
vocab.example: My head/tooth/back aches.
vocab.cn_example: 我的头／牙／背疼。

vocab.definition: something is of or from the cold, far-north part of the Earth
vocab.example: Polar bears live in the Arctic.
vocab.cn_example: 北极熊生活在北极地区。

vocab.definition: a path for water to travel through
vocab.example: The alimentary canal is the path by which food enters the body, and solid waste is passed out.
vocab.cn_example: 消化道是食物进入身体，固体废物排出身体的通道。

vocab.definition: a scientist who works with chemicals
vocab.example: After graduating, she worked as a chemist.
vocab.cn_example: 毕业后，她当上了一名药剂师。

vocab.definition: a feeling of cold
vocab.example: There was a chill in the air this morning.
vocab.cn_example: 今天早晨有点冷飕飕的。

vocab.definition: a group of leaders in a government
vocab.example: Both houses of Congress have rejected the recent presidential proposal on gun control.
vocab.cn_example: 国会两院否决了总统最近关于枪支的提案。

vocab.definition: something is made from milk
vocab.cn_meaning: 奶牛的;奶制品的，乳品的
vocab.example: I was advised not to eat too much dairy.
vocab.cn_example: 我被告知不要吃太多奶制品。

vocab.definition: to go downward
vocab.example: The path descended steeply into the valley.
vocab.cn_example: 这条路很陡，一直通到山谷。

vocab.definition: a person who sells food
vocab.cn_meaning: 食品杂货店店主（或店员）
vocab.example: At the other end of the social scale was the grocer.
vocab.cn_example: 处于社会阶层另一端的是杂货商。

vocab.definition: to wait for a short time before doing something
vocab.example: She hesitated slightly before answering the detective's question.
vocab.cn_example: 在回答警探的问题之前，她稍稍犹豫了一下。

vocab.definition: an organization that works to help a city or group of people
vocab.example: a medical/educational/financial institution
vocab.cn_example: 医疗／教育／金融机构

vocab.definition: to run slowly
vocab.cn_meaning: 慢跑（尤指作为健身锻炼的方式）
vocab.example: "What do you do to keep fit?" "I jog and go swimming."
vocab.cn_example: “你是怎样保持健康的？”“慢跑和游泳。”

vocab.definition: a person who sells things
vocab.example: a wine/grain merchant
vocab.cn_example: 酒商／粮食批发商

vocab.definition: to push something quickly with your finger or a pointed object
vocab.example: You'll poke someone in the eye with that umbrella if you're not careful!
vocab.cn_example: 你不小心的话伞尖会戳到别人眼睛的！

vocab.definition: to make it happen later than planned
vocab.example: They decided to postpone their holiday until next year.
vocab.cn_example: 他们决定将假期推迟到来年。

vocab.definition: to crash into something so that liquid spreads out
vocab.example: Several newspapers splashed colour pictures of the star across their front pages.
vocab.cn_example: 几份报纸在头版显着位置刊登了这位明星的多幅彩照。

vocab.definition: don’t change their minds easily
vocab.example: He was famed for his stubborn resistance and his refusal to accept defeat.
vocab.cn_example: 他以顽强抵抗、不甘失败著称。

vocab.definition: a small part of a large city
vocab.example: Box Hill is a suburb of Melbourne.
vocab.cn_example: 博士山属于墨尔本的近郊住宅区。

vocab.definition: the level of the water in the sea
vocab.example: high/low tide
vocab.cn_example: 高／低潮

vocab.definition: a very sad event
vocab.example: The pilot averted a tragedy when he succeeded in preventing the plane from crashing.
vocab.cn_example: 飞行员成功阻止了飞机的坠毁，从而避免了一场悲剧。

vocab.definition: an object that explodes and destroys large areas
vocab.example: During World War II, the British dropped a huge number of bombs on Dresden.
vocab.cn_example: 二战期间，英国在德累斯顿城投下了大量炸弹。

vocab.definition: a document that says that something is true or happened
vocab.example: a birth/marriage/death certificate
vocab.cn_example: 出生／结婚／死亡证明

vocab.definition: an event that makes a situation what it is
vocab.example: I think she coped very well under the circumstances.
vocab.cn_example: 我觉得在那种情况下她处理得很不错。

vocab.definition: a box used to bury dead people
vocab.example: Four soldiers stood guard over the coffin.
vocab.cn_example: 有四名士兵守护灵柩。

vocab.definition: to cope with a difficult or stressful situation means to deal with it
vocab.example: It's only been a year since he died - how's she coping (= how is she)?
vocab.cn_example: 他过世刚一年时间——她的情况怎么样？

vocab.definition: the act of saying that something is not correct or good
vocab.example: The designs for the new mosque have attracted widespread criticism.
vocab.cn_example: 人们普遍对新清真寺的设计不满意。

vocab.definition: to cause great damage or pain to that thing
vocab.example: A big worry is that these transplanted megafauna might devastate plants and animals that are native to the western United States.
vocab.cn_example: 最让人忧心的就是这些转移过来的巨型动物可能会毁灭美国西部一些土生土长的动植物。

vocab.definition: to make an unhappy look with one’s face
vocab.example: She frowned at me, clearly annoyed.
vocab.cn_example: 她皱着眉头看着我，显然是生气了。

vocab.definition: to look at it for a long time
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指因为惊奇、羡慕或心不在焉而）凝视，注视，盯着看
vocab.example: Annette gazed admiringly at Warren as he spoke.
vocab.cn_example: 沃伦说话时，安妮特一脸崇拜地注视着他。

vocab.definition: to look at it quickly
vocab.cn_meaning: 瞥一眼，迅速地看一眼，扫视
vocab.example: She glanced around/round the room to see who was there.
vocab.cn_example: 她扫视了一眼房间，看看谁在里面。

vocab.definition: the feeling of deep sadness, usually when a person dies
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指某人之死引起的）悲痛，悲伤，悲哀
vocab.example: Her grief at her son's death was terrible.
vocab.cn_example: 丧子之痛使她肝肠寸断。

vocab.definition: a man who is going to be married
vocab.example: Guests toasted the bride and groom with champagne.
vocab.cn_example: 客人们以香槟为新娘新郎敬酒。

vocab.definition: an official document that gives one permission to do something
vocab.example: The universities make discoveries and license them to a company.
vocab.cn_example: 大学做出发现并将其许可给一家公司。

vocab.definition: a device that makes small objects look bigger
vocab.example: They looked at the blood samples under the microscope.
vocab.cn_example: 他们在显微镜下观察血样。

vocab.definition: relates to the division or joining of atoms
vocab.example: nuclear fission/fusion/physics
vocab.cn_example: 核裂变／聚变／物理学

vocab.definition: to describe it or show it in a picture
vocab.example: The painting portrays a beautiful young woman in a blue dress.
vocab.cn_example: 这幅画描绘的是一位身穿蓝色连衣裙的美丽少女。

vocab.definition: to turn it around in a circle
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指围绕一个固定点）（使）旋转，（使）转动
vocab.example: Rotate the handle by 180° to open the door.
vocab.cn_example: 要想打开门，将把手旋转180度。

vocab.definition: something bought to remember of a place or event
vocab.example: He bought a model of a red London bus as a souvenir of his trip to London.
vocab.cn_example: 他买了一个红色的伦敦公共汽车模型，作为他伦敦之行的纪念。

vocab.definition: a boat that can go underwater for long periods of time
vocab.example: a nuclear submarine
vocab.cn_example: 核潜艇

vocab.definition: to follow over it with the eyes or a finger
vocab.example: The phone company was unable to trace the call.
vocab.cn_example: 电话公司查不出这个电话来自何处。

vocab.definition: the outline of a country’s coast
vocab.cn_meaning: （尤指从空中、海上或地图上看到的）海岸线
vocab.example: The coastline is being eaten away year by year.
vocab.cn_example: 海岸线年复一年地被侵蚀着。

vocab.definition: to prevent or discourage someone from doing something
vocab.example: These measures are designed to deter an enemy attack.
vocab.cn_example: 这些措施旨在阻止敌人的进攻。

vocab.definition: to come up with an idea or plan about it
vocab.cn_meaning: 巧妙构思;巧妙设计;发明
vocab.example: He's good at devising language games that you can play with students in class.
vocab.cn_example: 他善于设计可供师生在课堂上使用的语言游戏。

vocab.definition: how far it is between two points
vocab.example: What's the distance between Madrid and Barcelona/from Madrid to Barcelona?
vocab.cn_example: 马德里和巴塞罗那相距有多远？

vocab.definition: the knowledge and skills to do something well
vocab.example: We admired the expertise with which he prepared the meal.
vocab.cn_example: 我们很羡慕他那一手烹调绝活。

vocab.definition: a crack or break in something
vocab.example: He suffered/sustained multiple fractures in a motorcycle accident.
vocab.cn_example: 他在一起摩托车事故中多处骨折。

vocab.definition: a pain in one’s head
vocab.example: I've got a splitting (= severe) headache.
vocab.cn_example: 我头痛得很厉害。

vocab.definition: to ensure that what has been planned is done
vocab.example: garden/household/agricultural implements
vocab.cn_example: 园艺用具／家用工具／农具

vocab.definition: a deep and accurate understanding of something
vocab.example: It was an interesting book, full of fascinating insights into human relationships.
vocab.cn_example: 这是一本有趣的书，充满了对人际关系独到的见解。

vocab.definition: a large branch on a tree
vocab.example: An 18-year-old student at California State University died yesterday when she was struck by a falling limb from a large oak tree.
vocab.cn_example: 昨天，一位18岁的加州州立大学的学生被一棵大橡树上落下的粗树枝打中身亡。

vocab.definition: strength or power
vocab.example: Pizarro defeated the might of the Inca Empire with only a few hundred men.
vocab.cn_example: 皮萨罗依靠区区几百人打败了强大的印加帝国。

vocab.definition: the state of being hopeful about the future
vocab.example: There was a note of optimism in his voice as he spoke about the company's future.
vocab.cn_example: 谈到公司的未来，他语气里带着乐观情绪。

vocab.definition: able to do something well
vocab.example: a proficient swimmer
vocab.cn_example: 游泳好手

vocab.definition: a flat kind of boat
vocab.example: a raft of data
vocab.cn_example: 大量资料

vocab.definition: a long, narrow piece of raised land
vocab.example: We walked along the narrow mountain ridge.
vocab.cn_example: 我们沿着狭窄的山脊行进。

vocab.definition: the body part between the top of the arm and the neck
vocab.example: There were tire tracks left in the soft shoulder (= area of dirt or grass by the road).
vocab.cn_example: 在软路肩上有轮胎印子。

vocab.definition: to push it with a lot of power
vocab.example: She was jostled and shoved by an angry crowd as she left the court.
vocab.cn_example: 她离开法庭时，被愤怒的人群推来搡去。

vocab.definition: the person to whom someone is married
vocab.example: In 60 percent of the households surveyed both spouses went out to work.
vocab.cn_example: 在60%的被调查家庭中，夫妻双方都外出工作。

vocab.definition: to push or move something quickly with a lot of force
vocab.example: The main thrust of her argument was that women are compromised by the demands of childcare.
vocab.cn_example: 她的主要论点是妇女受到需要照看孩子的拖累。

vocab.definition: to be able to accept it even when it is unpleasant
vocab.example: These ants can tolerate temperatures that would kill other species.
vocab.cn_example: 这些蚂蚁能够忍受可以导致其他物种死亡的高温。
